content: Hello, I would like to place a delivery order, please.
Welcome to Karachi Kitchen! What would you like to order today?
I would like to order two chicken biryanis and one raita for delivery, please. Are those available, and what are their prices?
Yes, both are available. Chicken biryani is nine hundred rupees each, and raita is one hundred and fifty rupees.
Could you please let me know about the delivery fee, tax, and any minimum order requirement?
The delivery fee is one hundred and fifty rupees, there is no tax, and there is no minimum order.
Could you also make the food less spicy, if possible? And what is the total and delivery time, please?
We can definitely make it less spicy for you. May I please have your name?

My name is Ali Raza. The delivery address is House 12, Street 4, F-7/2, Islamabad, and my callback number is 0300-0000000. Also, could you please let me know the total and how long the delivery will take?
Thank you, Ali Raza. Your phone number is 0300-0000000, right?
Yes, that is correct. What is the total amount and when will it be delivered?
